Definition: properly, to be bright, i.e. (by implication) beautiful
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be bright, be beautiful, be handsome, be fair; 1a) (Qal) to be beautiful; 1b) (Piel) to beautify; 1c) (Pual) to be beautiful; 1d) (Hithpael) to beautify oneself
